description: V0.9c prospective preview evaluation (docs/benchmark/v09c-dev/PLAN.md): llm-agent 3 (the baseline, unchanged) and llm-agent 4 (the same agent with the simulator's existing preview shown before a staffing proposal is validated) with the two frozen models, beside no action, on suite dreamteam-dev version 4's financial-pressure-credit and staffing-shortage-credit, daily decisions at 07:00. No score, no ranking. Run from the repository root with DREAMTEAM_LLM_BASE_URL set. Two seeds, 30 days: 20 runs, 16 of them live LLM runs.
seedPlan: Chosen 2026-10-31 and committed in the V0.9c plan (docs/benchmark/v09c-dev/PLAN.md) before any run on them: the next unused block after V0.8c's 41900-41902. Neither appears as a seed anywhere in the repository before this plan; not a reference seed (1001-1020), not a V0.2 development seed (901-910), not a clinical calibration seed, not drawn from any reserved stream, not a benchmark holdout seed (none exists); the sealed clinical holdout guard accepts them.
